guide.summary: Public agent app, own Harvest OAuth app (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none).
guide.verdict: Public agent app, own Harvest OAuth app (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none).

composio.note: Composio manages OAuth for Harvest. For launch, create an auth config with your own client ID and secret, using the redirect URI copied from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio's managed app works. For production, bring your own app so users see your brand, you get dedicated quota, and you can use shorter trigger polling.
reasons: Branding: managed apps show 'Composio wants to access your account'
Quota: managed apps share quota across all Composio users
Polling: managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum interval
Control over scopes and rate limits through a custom auth config

scenarios.label: Public agent app, own Harvest OAuth app
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects many customers' Harvest accounts through an OAuth2 app you register in Harvest ID.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: The docs describe no review step (c3); no waiting time is documented either way.

scenarios.approval: No app review, verification or partner acceptance is described for OAuth2 registration. Directory listing is a separate optional form.

prerequisites.title: Harvest account with admin rights
prerequisites.detail: Older V1 docs say you must be an Administrator on your Harvest account to register an OAuth app. Confirm the same for the current Harvest ID flow.

prerequisites.title: Decide product scope
prerequisites.detail: You choose Harvest, Forecast or both at registration, and Harvest advises picking the minimal scope.

steps.title: Get redirect URI from Composio dashboard
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it is a valid URL to register as the Harvest Redirect URL.
steps.done_when: You have the exact redirect URI to register.

steps.title: Register OAuth2 app in Harvest ID
steps.detail: In the Developers section of Harvest ID, enter the app name, redirect URL, multi-account setting and product scope.
steps.done_when: Harvest shows a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Harvest auth config through Composio's API using your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a connect link can be generated.

steps.title: Test a connection end to end
steps.detail: Authorize a Harvest account through the connect link and run a few API calls. Check that token refresh works after the 18-hour expiry.
steps.done_when: Calls succeed and a refreshed token works.

steps.title: Optionally request a directory listing
steps.detail: Submit Harvest's integration form to appear in its integrations directory. It is a marketing listing and not needed to connect users.
steps.done_when: The integrations team has your request.

traps.title: Greenhouse 'Harvest' docs are a different product
traps.detail: Search results for 'Harvest API' also return Greenhouse's recruiting API, which needs a signed partner agreement. None of that applies to Harvest time tracking.

traps.title: Short-lived access tokens
traps.detail: Access tokens expire after 18 hours, so your agent must refresh them using the refresh token.

traps.title: Rate limits block the account
traps.detail: General API calls are limited to 100 per 15 seconds and Reports API calls to 100 per 15 minutes. Exceeding them returns HTTP 429.

traps.title: Managed app is not for launch
traps.detail: It shows 'Composio' on the consent screen and shares quota with all Composio users.

traps.title: Old docs describe V1
traps.detail: V1 is deprecated and only supported for legacy apps. Follow the V2 docs for new builds.

open_questions: Is there any hidden review, user cap or wait for public OAuth2 apps? Not found; ask Harvest support or test with a second organization's account.
Does a customer's Harvest admin need to approve your app? Docs do not mention it; test with a non-admin customer user.
Are token lifetimes the same in V2? The 18-hour figure comes from V1 docs and a GitHub copy; verify in the V2 flow.
Does Harvest validate redirect URIs beyond the 'must start with the registered URL' rule? Test with the Composio callback.
